title: Dad has a “new number”
scenario: A familiar profile photo appears on WhatsApp from a new number: “Old phone died. Please delete the old contact.” An hour later, “Dad” asks you to pay an invoice because his banking app is still locked.

answers.A: Ask for a voice or video call and verify something current before trusting the new number.
answers.B: Pay if the invoice is for a company or bill you recognize.
answers.C: Call your father on a known number or verify with another family member before changing the contact or paying anything.

explanation: Recognizing the bill does not authenticate the person asking you to pay it. New numbers deserve independent confirmation.
proTip: New number + money request = verify the person first.
